rows.job_description:
Position Overview

As an AI Engineer at Prescient, you will build and deploy GenAI / agentic AI systems that power our competitive intelligence products in the pharmaceutical and life sciences space. Your role involves developing LLM agents that query external data sources, creating retrieval pipelines over specialized content, implementing evaluation frameworks, and building APIs and dashboards that deliver insights to analysts and clients. You will work in a fast-paced environment with tight feedback loops, real users, and short release cycles, directly contributing to Prescient's technology-driven competitive advantage in the life sciences consulting sector.




Example Responsibilities

Design and implement agentic AI systems that query external data sources and process pharmaceutical and biotech information
Develop robust retrieval pipelines over specialized life sciences content to extract valuable competitive intelligence
Create and maintain evaluation harnesses to ensure accuracy, reliability, and ethical operation of AI systems
Engineer production-grade prompts and structured-output parsing mechanisms for consistent AI performance
Build and optimize RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) stacks to enhance knowledge retrieval from domain-specific content
Develop REST APIs using FastAPI or similar frameworks to integrate AI capabilities into Prescient's product ecosystem
Design and implement dashboards that effectively communicate AI-generated insights to analysts and clients
Collaborate with data scientists and domain experts to continuously improve AI system performance and relevance
Write clean, typed, and well-tested Python code following best practices for maintainability and scalability
Troubleshoot complex issues in multi-turn agent interactions and implement robust error handling mechanisms



Education, Experience, Knowledge & Other Skills

Required

34 years experience writing production Python, including async, typed and tested code
Experience shipping an agentic system involving tool calling, multi-turn state and failure handling
Experience building or maintaining an evaluation set for LLM output
Production prompt engineering and structured-output parsing expertise
Experience building one RAG stack end to end
REST API development using FastAPI or similar frameworks
Relational database fundamentals and ability to write non-trivial SQL queries
B.Tech, M.Tech, MCA, or equivalent education

Preferred

Agent harness engineering, including execution environments, sandboxing, permissions, context management, retries, interrupts and sub-agent spawning
Agent control-loop design, including self-verification, stopping criteria, turn limits and recoverable error handling
Experience with LangGraph, Strands, MCP or AWS Bedrock AgentCore
Familiarity with Braintrust, LangSmith, Promptfoo, DeepEval or equivalent evaluation tooling
Life sciences or pharma data exposure
Front-end development for internal tools using HTML, JavaScript, charting libraries or React
Experience with Docker, ECS or Kubernetes



What We Offer

Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI systems with direct impact on pharmaceutical and life sciences decision-making
Collaborative environment with a team of technology and domain experts
Clear career progression path with mentorship from senior technical leaders
Professional development opportunities including training, and certifications
Competitive compensation package with comprehensive benefits
Flexible hybrid working arrangement at our Gurugram office

rows.job_title: Senior Generative AI Engineer - RAG, LLMs and MLOps | WFH | UK Client
rows.job_description:
Key Responsibilities

Design and develop enterprise Generative AI and LLM-based applications.
Build RAG pipelines connecting LLMs with private company data, documents, databases and knowledge repositories.
Develop document ingestion, cleaning, chunking, embedding, indexing and retrieval workflows.
Implement semantic search, hybrid search, metadata filtering, reranking and source attribution.
Design and manage vector databases such as Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant, Chroma, FAISS or pgvector.
Select and evaluate suitable embedding models, vector indexes and similarity-search techniques.
Fine-tune open-source models such as Llama, Mistral, Gemma or Qwen using domain-specific data.
Apply techniques such as LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT, quantisation and prompt tuning.
Develop scalable APIs and backend services using Python, FastAPI or similar frameworks.
Integrate LLMs with enterprise applications, APIs, databases and business workflows.
Deploy AI services using cloud platforms, Docker and Kubernetes.
Implement CI/CD pipelines for AI applications and model deployments.
Optimise AI systems for latency, throughput, reliability and inference cost.
Implement caching, asynchronous processing, rate limiting, load balancing and autoscaling.
Monitor model performance, token consumption, API errors, infrastructure utilisation and cloud costs.
Build evaluation frameworks to measure accuracy, relevance, groundedness and retrieval quality.
Identify and reduce hallucinations, irrelevant retrieval and inconsistent responses.
Implement AI security controls to prevent prompt injection, data leakage and unauthorised access.
Prepare technical documentation and participate in architecture and code reviews.
Collaborate with product managers, data engineers, software developers and UK-based stakeholders.
Mentor junior engineers and contribute to AI engineering standards and best practices.



Required Skills

3 to 8 years of experience in AI, machine learning, data science, backend engineering or software development.
Hands-on experience building production-level Generative AI or LLM applications.
Strong experience with Retrieval-Augmented Generation.
Experience with vector databases and semantic search.
Strong Python programming skills.
Experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack, Semantic Kernel or similar frameworks.
Experience using OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Gemini, Anthropic or similar LLM APIs.
Experience with open-source models and Hugging Face Transformers.
Understanding of embeddings, transformers, tokenisation and model inference.
Experience developing REST APIs and backend services.
Knowledge of Git, testing and software-engineering best practices.
Experience with cloud deployment and production application monitoring.
Strong problem-solving and communication skills.
Ability to work remotely during UK business hours.



Preferred Skills

Hands-on experience fine-tuning Large Language Models.
Knowledge of LoRA, QLoRA, PEFT and model quantisation.
Experience with PyTorch or TensorFlow.
Experience with Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, Qdrant, Chroma, FAISS, Elasticsearch, OpenSearch or pgvector.
Experience with vLLM, NVIDIA Triton or Hugging Face Text Generation Inference.
Knowledge of Docker, Kubernetes and CI/CD.
Experience with MLflow, LangSmith, Weights & Biases or similar tools.
Understanding of GPU deployment and inference optimisation.
Knowledge of Azure, AWS or Google Cloud AI services.
Experience with SQL, NoSQL databases and data pipelines.
Understanding of responsible AI, model safety and LLM security.
Experience in healthcare, legal, finance, engineering or another specialised domain will be an advantage.



Qualifications

Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Data Science, Engineering or a related field.




Candidates with strong practical AI engineering experience may also be considered.




Why Apply?

Permanent work-from-home opportunity.
Work directly with a UK-based client.
Regular full-time and freelance options available.
Work on advanced enterprise Generative AI projects.
Hands-on exposure to RAG, LLMs, vector databases and model fine-tuning.
Build and deploy AI solutions used by real business teams.
Opportunity to work on the complete AI application lifecycle.
Long-term career growth in Generative AI and machine learning engineering.
